description: Header file defining the OpenH264 video decoder class within the starboard shared openh264 namespace. It declares the VideoDecoder class with methods for initialization, decoding, resetting, and managing decode targets, along with internal data structures and external dependencies.

classes.name: VideoDecoder
classes.description: A class implementing a video decoder using OpenH264, supporting initialization, decoding, resetting, and managing decode targets, with internal queues and threading.

methods.name: VideoDecoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the VideoDecoder with codec, output mode, and graphics context provider.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with status and error callbacks.

methods.name: GetPrerollFrameCount
methods.description: Returns the number of preroll frames (8).

methods.name: WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Feeds input buffers into the decoder.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the decoder.
